The social engineering tactic present in this text is **pretexting**.

The attacker creates a fabricated scenario (a conference meeting, interest in work, potential investor connections) to establish a false sense of legitimacy and rapport. This pretext is used to manipulate Craig into revealing sensitive information (the project proposal) under the guise of a professional opportunity. The question about the animal is a distraction or a test to see if the victim is paying attention to the actual request versus irrelevant details.
